entities.summary: Patrick Jerome Hillings was an American lawyer, World War II veteran, and politician who served four terms as a Republican U.S. Representative from California. He succeeded Richard M. Nixon in Congress and was initially elected to California's 12th congressional district, which was renumbered as California's 25th congressional district prior to the 1952 election.
